description: Tech Stack — Azure suggestions for .NET project

assert.value: Suggestions must be Azure-related technologies appropriate for a .NET stack (e.g. Azure Functions, Azure App Service, Azure DevOps). Must not repeat C# or .NET. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Role — platform engineer suggestions from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be job role titles that include or relate to 'platform'. Must not repeat 'Developer'. At most 5 suggestions, each 1-3 words.

description: Remote — suggestions from empty partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be remote work terms (e.g. Fully Remote, Work from Home, Distributed). Must not repeat 'Remote'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Exclude Terms — seniority level exclusions

assert.value: Suggestions must be seniority-related terms that someone would exclude (e.g. principal, staff, senior required). Must not repeat 'security clearance'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Tech Stack — Next.js and related for React project

assert.value: Suggestions must match the 'next' partial and be relevant to a React/JavaScript stack (e.g. Next.js, TypeScript, Nuxt.js). Must not repeat React or JavaScript. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Tech Stack — data tools for Python/Django project

assert.value: Suggestions must be data-related Python tools (e.g. pandas, Apache Spark, dbt, NumPy). Must not repeat Python or Django. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Role — data roles from empty existing list

assert.value: Suggestions must be job role titles that start with or include 'data'. No existing keywords to avoid repeating. At most 5 suggestions, each a valid job title.

description: Role — related engineering roles from empty partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be engineering role titles related to backend work. Must not repeat 'Backend Engineer'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Visa — suggestions from empty list and empty partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be visa or sponsorship-related terms suitable for a job search chip (e.g. no sponsorship required, H1B welcome). At most 5 suggestions, 1-3 words each.

description: Visa — clearance-related exclusions from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must match the 'clear' partial and relate to clearance exclusions. Must not repeat 'no sponsorship required'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Timezone — UTC suggestions from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be UTC timezone identifiers that match the 'UTC' prefix. At most 5 suggestions. No existing keywords to avoid.

description: Timezone — EST and related from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must match or relate to the 'EST' partial and be timezone identifiers. Must not repeat UTC+0 or UTC+1. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Exclude Terms — relocation suggestions from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must match the 'relo' partial and be exclusion phrases related to relocation (e.g. relocation required, must relocate). At most 5 suggestions.

description: Exclude Terms — additional exclusions from empty partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be common job search exclusion phrases. Must not repeat 'security clearance'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Tech Stack — cloud tools for Java/Spring project

assert.value: Suggestions must be cloud-related technologies that pair well with Java/Spring. Must not repeat Java or Spring. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Role — cloud and infra roles from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be role titles matching the 'cloud' partial or closely related. Must not repeat 'DevOps Engineer'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Timezone — additional US timezones from empty partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be timezone identifiers not already listed. Must not repeat EST or PST. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Tech Stack — frontend framework suggestions from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be frontend technologies matching the 'front' partial or commonly used in frontend development. No existing keywords to avoid. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Visa — sponsorship terms from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must match the 'sponsor' partial and be visa sponsorship-related terms. Must not repeat 'no clearance' or 'no polygraph'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Exclude Terms — employment type exclusions from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must match the 'part' partial or be employment type exclusions. Must not repeat 'relocation required'. At most 5 suggestions.

description: Timezone — African timezone identifiers from partial

assert.value: Suggestions must be African timezone identifiers or named zones relevant to the 'Africa' partial — such as WAT (West Africa Time, UTC+1), EAT (East Africa Time, UTC+3), CAT (Central Africa Time, UTC+2). Must not repeat UTC+1. At most 5 suggestions.
